statement: Only a family's current generation moves it: a refresh of the current generation moves the family to its next generation with a conditional write of the record it read, so of concurrent refreshes of one pair exactly one moves it, on one instance or many. A refresh of any other generation never moves it.
guards: login:TokenFamiliesTest#refreshes of one pair racing move the family once
cocache:CoCacheTokenFamilyStoreTest#refreshes of one pair racing on two instances move the family once
jwt:RefreshTokenFamiliesJwtTest#a retried refresh heals, and only the current pair moves the session on
